checks.name: Normalized decisions preserve all eleven live gate outcomes
A complete report retains failed cases instead of claiming all checks passed
Unsupported classification retains both mobile GraphTool grading failures
Verified but unbatched economics remains disabled
Batch withdrawal disables all six without deleting evidence or identities
Entry enable flag alone cannot authorize an exercise
Runtime mismatch invalidates every otherwise enabled decision
Source hash changes keep old observations but mark the decision stale
Incomplete report and duplicate seed/viewport coverage cannot confer approval
One missing mandatory ownership check blocks an otherwise correct case
Same declared capabilities never substitute for per-file evidence
Changing capability requirements makes prior evidence stale
A passing retry cannot erase retained failure observations
Historical worker, approval and attempt identities are not invented
Normalization and hypothetical decisions do not mutate the live input snapshot

scope: Read-only normalization and hypothetical model decisions using the actual catalog assessor. No new PG/browser acceptance, database migration or activation.
